title: Stay in the Bowl
description: Juggle tumbling marbles, candies, and quirky shapes inside a tilting ceramic bowl—keep every piece balanced inside until the timer ticks down.
controls: Drag to aim each drop gently into the bowl so nothing spills over the rim.

zh-CN.title: 别离开碗
zh-CN.description: 魔性脑洞物理平衡别离开碗：精准把控落点把各式搞怪物品全装进小碗里，倒计时结束一颗不掉才算赢！
zh-CN.controls: 调整上方物品位置轻轻投放进碗中，保持堆叠平衡直到倒计时结束不溢出。
